thread:
jamie: Heads up — deploy-bot aborted the promote from staging to canary. Preflight tests failed.
deploy-bot: promotion aborted (exit code 1). Failing job: staging-preflight. See log snippet below.

jamie: failing test is `tests/test_cache.py::test_redis_fixture` — it hung and hit the pytest timeout (~60s).

sam: I can reproduce locally with `pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_redis_fixture -k redis -vv` — it stalls in the fixture teardown. stack shows aioredis waiting on connection.

maria: I merged #4221 yesterday that changed the redis fixture scope from `session` -> `module` to try and speed tests. Might be related.

lee: if we can't unblock quickly can we pin staging to the previous image sha to let the release proceed?

jamie: yes. pin to `sha:abc1234` and do a manual promote. We should hold rollout until we have a fix or revert. @deploy-bot please create manual promotion and lock.

anthony: creating manual promote now and adding a hold tag. I'll also start drafting release notes noting the pin and the fix follow-up.

sam: quick repro steps I used:
```bash
git checkout origin/main
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest tests/test_cache.py::test_redis_fixture -vv -k redis
```
Output ends with:
```
E   redis.exceptions.TimeoutError: Connection timed out
>   await conn.execute('PING')
```

maria: thanks — I'll open a revert PR to change the fixture back to `session` scope. If that's risky, I'll instead add explicit cleanup to ensure connections close.

lee: alternative quick mitigation: bump pytest fixture timeout in staging to 120s so preflight can pass while we revert. Any objections?

jamie: fine as stopgap but prefer revert. Do both: bump timeout for now, pin staging image, manual promote. We must not auto-promote.

oncall-bot: paging @oncall — are you available to monitor the manual promote and rollback window?

deploy-bot: manual promote created: `manual-promote-1755009876-01`, pinned to sha `abc1234`, status: ON_HOLD. Auto-promote disabled.

anthony: added `hold` label and a note in the release checklist.

maria: PR opened: #4234 revert(redis-fixture-scope). I'll add CI fix tests and request review.

sam: once manual promote completes I will run the staging smoke suite and sanity-check redis behavior.

jamie: thanks all. action items: (1) keep manual promote held until #4234 merges + validated, (2) anthony to update release notes, (3) sam to run post-promote smoke. ping this thread for status updates.

lee: marking this thread as the coordination point. :white_check_mark:
